docs.summary: Converts pixels between the layouts in [`PixelFormat`](#api~Prowl.Aperture.PixelFormat). Widening a channel replicates its bits rather than shifting, so full intensity stays full, and narrowing is the exact inverse and therefore rounds. A missing alpha reads as opaque, and greyscale expands by copying its one channel rather than by any weighting.
